358215.title: Exact 2-dimensional flow number conjecture for the Petersen graph
358215.statement:
Let $P$ be the Petersen graph, and let $phi_2(P)$ denote its $2$-dimensional flow number.

**Petersen graph flow-number conjecture.**

$$
\phi_2(P)=1+\sqrt{7/3}.
$$

The paper gives the matching upper bound and proposes equality based on computational evidence; no proof of the lower bound is known.

Best squared max/min norm ratio is 2.333333333333334, consistent with 7/3; no strict improvement found.

360521.title: Havet–Thomassé conjecture for trees with few leaves

literal_record.title: Havet–Thomassé conjecture for trees with few leaves
literal_record.statement: Let $T$ be an oriented tree with $k$ edges and $ll$ leaves, and let a tournament be an orientation of a complete graph. **Havet–Thomassé's conjecture.** Every tournament on $k+\ell$ vertices contains a copy of $T$. The bound is motivated by the sharper behavior of paths and trees with few leaves; later results give near-linear bounds, but the stated bound is not known in general.
literal_record.source_name: Maya Stein, “Oriented trees and paths in digraphs”, arXiv:2310.18719 (2024).
literal_record.references:
**3 papers in this index state this conjecture** (2010–2023). The statement above is taken from the most recent of them; the others are [arXiv:1912.04004](https://arxiv.org/abs/1912.04004), [arXiv:1010.4429](https://arxiv.org/abs/1010.4429).

Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2310.18719

360522.title: Havet's chromatic conjecture for trees with few leaves
360522.literal_statement: Let $k\in\mathbb N$, let $\ell\in\mathbb N$, let $D$ be a digraph, and let $T$ be an oriented tree with $k$ edges and $\ell$ leaves. **Havet's conjecture.** Every $(k+\ell)$-chromatic digraph contains every oriented $k$-edge tree having $\ell$ leaves. This generalizes Burr's chromatic conjecture and the tournament conjecture for trees with few leaves; it is known only in restricted cases.

374022.title: The periodic efficient total girth coloring conjecture for cubic maps

full_record.title: The periodic efficient total girth coloring conjecture for cubic maps
full_record.statement: Let $M(G)$ be a connected simple cubic map of girth $4$ embedded in a genus-realizing orientable surface, and suppose all its belts have lengths $\ell$ with $\ell\equiv 0\pmod 4$. Let a DETGC and an RETGC denote the two types of efficient total girth colorings used in the source, let a 3PFC denote an associated 3-permutation face coloring, and let $G\square K_2$ be the prism graph. **Periodic efficient total girth coloring conjecture.** Such a map contains DETGCs and RETGCs with associated 3PFCs from which the original colorings can be recovered, yielding unique induced EGCs in $G\square K_2$. This is the paper's broad correspondence claim; the supplied text does not state a resolution.
full_record.source_name: Italo J Dejter, “Periodic efficient total girth colorings in cubic maps of girth 4 correspond to 3-permutation face colorings”, arXiv:2604.02991 (2026).

349115.title: Face-lattice conjecture for partial permutohedra
349115.literal_statement: Let $\mathcal{P}(m,n)$ be the partial permutohedron and let $\mathcal{B}_m$ be the Boolean lattice of subsets of $[m]$. For a chain in $\mathcal{B}_m$, the difference between its largest and smallest nonempty subsets means the difference of their ranks. **Face-lattice conjecture.** Faces of $\mathcal{P}(m,n)$ are in bijection with chains in $\mathcal{B}_m$ whose difference between largest and smallest nonempty subsets is at most $n-1$. A face of $\mathcal{P}(m,n)$ has dimension $k$ if and only if the corresponding chain has $k$ missing ranks. This conjecture extends the established characterization for $\mathcal{P}(m,m)$ and proposes a corresponding description when $m\ne n$.

360525.title: Minimum-semidegree conjecture for balanced antidirected trees
360525.literal_statement: Let $D$ be an oriented graph on $n$ vertices, let $\delta^0(D)$ denote its minimum semidegree, and let a balanced antidirected tree have equally many sources and sinks. **The balanced-tree conjecture.** Every oriented $n$-vertex graph $D$ with $\delta^0(D)>k/2$ contains every balanced antidirected $k$-edge tree whose total maximum degree is at most $o(n)$. The conjecture concerns the threshold below the trivial greedy bound and remains open.

374023.title: The constructive generation conjecture for efficient total girth colorings
374023.literal_statement: Let $G$ be a finite connected simple cubic graph of girth $4$, and let an ETGC denote an efficient total girth coloring. The six constructive tools considered in the source are sprays, extensions, unfoldings, exchanges, amalgams, and piercing; sprays yield the smallest such graph, $G=Q_3$. **Constructive generation conjecture.** ETGCs of finite connected simple cubic graphs of girth $4$ are obtained solely by means of these six constructive tools. The supplied text does not establish whether this proposed completeness statement is proved or remains open.
374023.source_name: Italo J Dejter, “Periodic efficient total girth colorings in cubic maps of girth 4 correspond to 3-permutation face colorings”, arXiv:2604.02991 (2026).
374023.definitions_and_quantifiers: ETGCs are efficient total girth colorings on cubic girth-4 maps, with source surface/face conditions. Literal record lists six tools; current source has seven, adding PDS-complementation.

source_conjecture_blocks.text: Conjecture 65 . Let  $M(G)$  be a toroidal map whose 1-skeleton is a connected simple cubic  $\Pi$  -graph of girth 4. If  $G$  is toroidally 3-edge connected, then  $M(G)$  admits an ETGC.

Conjecture 73 . All connected simple cubic  $\Pi$  -maps  $M(G)$  of girth 4 in genus-realizing orientable surfaces contain DETGCs (resp. RETGCs) with associated PFCs from which the original DETGCs (resp. RETGCs) can be recovered, allowing unique induced EGCs in the prisms  $G\square K_{2}$  .

Conjecture 74 . ETGCs of maps of finite connected simple cubic graphs  $G$  of girth 4 are obtained solely by means of the following seven constructive tools: spray (Definition 18 ),
yielding the smallest such  $G$  , namely  $G=Q_{3}$  (as in Corollary 21 ),
extension (Definition 45 ),
unfolding (Definition 49 ), exchange (Definition 53 ), amalgam (Definition 62 ), piercing (Section 7 ) and PDS-complementation (Section 8 ).
Question 75 . Can Definition 63 and Conjecture 65 be generalized for the cases of  $2g$  -cutouts of  $g$  -toroidal graphs, for a notion of  $g$  -toroidally 3-edge connected simple cubic graph ?

372616.title: Duality conjecture for normed flow indices
372616.statement:
Let $G$ be a bridgeless graph and let $d\ge 2$ be an integer. For $p\in[1,2]$ and $q\in[2,\infty]$, write $\phi_{d,p}(G)$ and $\phi_{d,q}(G)$ for the corresponding flow indices. **Duality conjecture for normed flow indices.** For every $p\in[1,2]$, there exists $q\in[2,\infty]$ such that

$$
\phi_{d,p}(G)=\phi_{d,q}(G),
$$

and conversely, for every $q\in[2,\infty]$, there exists $p\in[1,2]$ satisfying the same equality. The source contrasts this with the usual duality relation $1/p+1/q=1$ and leaves the asserted existence open.

372618.title: The generalized $S^2_p$-flow conjecture
372618.statement:
For a bridgeless graph $G$, let

$$
S_p^{d-1}:=\{\boldsymbol{x}\in\mathbb{R}^d:\lVert\boldsymbol{x}\rVert_p=1\}
$$

be the unit $p$-sphere. **The generalized $S^2_p$-flow conjecture.** For every bridgeless graph $G$ and every $p\in[1,\infty]$,

$$
\phi_{3,p}(G)=2.
$$

This extends Jain's $S^2$-flow conjecture from the Euclidean sphere to all $p$-norms. The source notes that the case $p=\infty$ is proved, while the general assertion is suggested using the preceding monotonicity and duality conjectures.

360524.title: Stein's minimum-semidegree conjecture for oriented paths

actual_disposition.title: Stein's minimum-semidegree conjecture for oriented paths
actual_disposition.literal_statement: Let $k\in\mathbb N$, and let $\delta^0(D)$ denote the minimum semidegree of an oriented graph $D$. **Stein's conjecture.** Every oriented graph with $\delta^0(D)>k/2$ contains every oriented path with $k$ edges. 360352.title: The half-breadth internally 4-connected minor conjecture
360352.literal_statement: Let $M$ be a matroid with a tangle $\mathcal{T}$ of order $k\geq 4$ and breadth $m$. **The half-breadth internally 4-connected minor conjecture.** The matroid $M$ has an internally $4$-connected minor $N$ with a tangle $\mathcal{T}'$ of order $k$ such that $\mathcal{T}$ generates $\mathcal{T}'$ in $N$ and the breadth of $\mathcal{T}'$ is at least $m/2$. This would strengthen the weakly $4$-connected outcome available when breadth is preserved exactly, by allowing a controlled loss of breadth; the conjecture is stated as an open problem in the paper.
